48.original: Brigid can readjust your phantom weaponry attributes.

49.original: Do you seek to alter the attributes of your phantom weapon? A simple enough task, with sufficient resources.

51.original: Readjust the attributes of your phantom weaponry.

52.original: Learn about readjusting phantom weaponry attributes.

54.original: The three attributes you added to your phantom weaponry can be reselected or rebalanced. As with the initial augmentation, one of these attributes will be set to a lower value than the other two.

55.original: Once you have readjusted the values to your liking, select “Confirm” to finalize your decision.

56.original: Resetting your weaponry's attributes will require an additional chunk of ecliptic arcanite, so consider your choices carefully.

57.original: I require a single chunk of ecliptic arcanite to facilitate the readjustment. I shall leave its procurement in your capable hands.

58.original: Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.

59.original: I'm afraid the process is tailored specifically to phantom weaponry. Might I ask you to equip suitable armaments before beginning?

60.original: A thoroughly successful readjustment! Of course, if you wish to explore a subtly different configuration in the future, you need but ask.

61.original: Your phantom weaponry (<hex:020837E3E94509FF1202280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E9450103FF1E02081AE1E94513FF1202280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E9450103FF010303>) has been readjusted.
